findings.summary: verify exits 0 ('OK ... chain-only verification') when anchors.jsonl is ABSENT or EMPTY. Reviewer tamper: truncate the ledger to 80 entries (or delete-and-recompute) and remove or empty anchors.jsonl -> exit 0. docs/06 s8 defines 0 as 'verified'; docs/06 s13.3 rev 1 records a moved-away anchor as UNVERIFIED exit 3; constitution 11.4.268(C)/(D) require a tamper-free verdict to name BOTH chain and anchor results and an unreachable anchor to REFUSE. The note on stdout does not change the exit status gates read. test_anchors.sh lines 46/53 assert this exit 0, so the defect is encoded as expected behaviour. Fix direction: no anchor => exit 3 UNVERIFIED (or an explicit --chain-only opt-in that never returns 0 as 'verified').

The live store is unanchored: specs/.../evidence/ledger.jsonl holds 90 entries and $EV/anchors.jsonl does not exist and has never been committed (git log --all on the path is empty). docs/06 s8 requires an anchor at the end of every measuring session; nothing in evrec run or any wrapper writes one. Today the real evidence has NO protection against delete-and-recompute or tail truncation (reviewer run on a scratch copy: both pass verify with exit 0). Wire anchor writing (end of session / declared interval) and record the first anchor.

Anchor strength is NOT honestly bounded to policy: `evrec anchor --probe-remote <bare repo>` on a same-uid local bare repo with receive.denyNonFastForwards/denyDeletes=true writes strength=mechanism (reviewer run: 'anchored count=90 ... strength=mechanism'; repo owner = the producer uid). The anchor row is still written to the rewritable anchors.jsonl beside the ledger, never to the probed remote, and the producer can flip that remote's config. Contradicts docs/06 s8 (rewrite-rejection must be evidenced; single-uid host => policy), constitution 11.4.240(F)/11.4.268(C), and the module's own text 'until OD-76 is answered the anchors stay in $EV/anchors.jsonl and are policy'. The default path (no probe) is honestly policy.

verify trusts a self-asserted mechanism row: a hand-written row {strength:mechanism, probe:{rewrite_rejected:true, probe_kind:config, remote:'/nonexistent'}} over a truncated 80-entry ledger is reported 'anchor agrees ... strength=mechanism', exit 0. The strength is never re-derived or bounded at verify time (A5/A19 only check the row's shape).

The verdict deriver never compares anchors (chain_walk only). On the reviewer's anchored delete-and-recompute ledger (verify exit 2) `verdict AUD-T164` still derives PASS exit 0; on a forged ledger with a fabricated RED inserted for AUD-T180 and the chain recomputed (verify exit 2), red_ok, red_before_green and fingerprints_differ flip to true. The deriver's own refusal text promises 'no verdict is derived from a ledger that does not verify'. Deriver must apply the same anchor comparison (and the R1 absent-anchor rule) as verify.

Mutants A17, A18, A18b are recorded CAUGHT in t055b-mutations.txt on exactly that FAIL line, so those three catches prove nothing. Neither harness runs an unmutated-baseline control (11.4.201(6) false match). With the guide copied the baseline is clean (reviewer REV-0: 0 FAIL lines) - re-run A17/A18/A18b with the fixed tree and add a baseline-green precondition.
